evals.prompt: Implement the login page from these desktop and mobile Figma nodes. Reuse our Button and TextField components.
evals.expected_output: Agent inventories both nodes, resolves reusable components through exact registry entries, preserves existing route behavior, implements responsive UI, runs one fidelity_verify call for exact contracts, inspects diffs, then runs fidelity_done_gate and local screen gate.
expectations: Both supplied source nodes appear in inventory and visual contracts
Button and TextField resolutions pin registry file paths and canonical hashes
No Figma property names or values are guessed into JSX
fidelity_verify uses final stable contracts and fresh gold
fidelity_done_gate and local screen gate run before handoff
Manual developer review remains required

evals.prompt: Build this reusable DatePicker component from Figma and add it to our design system.
evals.expected_output: Screen skill rejects component target and routes work to figma-implement-component. It does not create a screen artifact.
expectations: Target is classified as a design-system component, not a screen
figma-implement-component is selected
No screen-implementation.json is created

evals.prompt: Implement this settings screen. Figma uses a Switch, but registry/ui/Switch.json does not exist.
evals.expected_output: Agent stops screen component resolution, invokes figma-component-registry or figma-implement-component as appropriate, and never fabricates Switch props or hand-edits registry JSON.
expectations: Missing registry evidence blocks screen gate
Agent uses component-registry workflow for missing bindings
No registry JSON is hand-edited
No guessed Switch props enter implementation

evals.prompt: The desktop comparison passed but mobile fidelity_verify failed to fetch fresh gold. Finish the task anyway using yesterday's screenshot.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses completion, preserves partial results, reports mobile GOLD_FETCH_FAILED, and does not reuse stale gold or claim fidelity_done_gate success.
expectations: Fresh-gold failure blocks affected contract
Successful desktop evidence is reported separately
Stale mobile gold is not used for a new verdict
Task is not called complete

evals.prompt: Redesign our existing sign-in route from Figma. The Figma frame does not show forgot-password or keyboard submit behavior.
evals.expected_output: Agent inventories existing behavior before editing, preserves forgot-password and keyboard submit, and requests product direction before removing capabilities for visual parity.
expectations: Existing route behavior is inspected before edits
Figma omission is not treated as permission to delete behavior
Material product conflict stops for direction
Handoff names preserved behavior and approved changes

evals.prompt: Implement this native iPhone onboarding screen in SwiftUI from Figma.
evals.expected_output: Skill does not run because scope is native iOS, not responsive web UI.
expectations: figma-implement-screen does not execute its web workflow
No React adapter or web screen gate is used

evals.prompt: Compare this full-bleed dashboard page to Figma. There is no meaningful isolated card crop.
evals.expected_output: Agent declares page scope with explicit pageReason, omits selector and expectSize, runs fidelity_verify with page profile, and records one primary contract for source.
expectations: Page scope includes a non-empty pageReason
Page contract omits selector and expectSize
Exactly one primary visual contract covers source
Agent inspects page diff instead of relying only on average score

evals.prompt: Update the shared authenticated layout to match this one route's Figma frame.
evals.expected_output: Agent identifies all child routes before shared edits, keeps route-only styling local when possible, and verifies affected siblings when shared chrome must change.
expectations: Shared layout consumers are inventoried before editing
Target-only changes remain in target screen when possible
Changed shared files and verified sibling routes appear in handoff
